name: Pricing
summary: Pricing sections for the AhaSlides marketing sites (Webflow Pricing): ten section layouts and twelve plan card styles, in the layouts of the Untitled UI pricing sections the marketing team picked. Every plan is the new Pricing card from the Cards page, so the sections only add the grid, a working Monthly/Yearly toggle and a comparison table around it. Framework-free HTML, CSS and a short script, bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Eleven previews on one page: ten section layouts (four simple cards, four featured cards, two large tables) and one gallery of the twelve single-plan card styles, each with its own paste-and-run snippet

Two backgrounds: White (the default) and Accent, the pale pink bgAccent surface laid over white by adding aha-pricing--accent to the section; plan cards, tables and icon squares are white, so they stay visible; the Plan card styles gallery has no switch because it already demonstrates the pink bands

Layout copied from Untitled UI; colour, type, space, radius and icons are the DS ones, with Vivid Pink as the Most popular highlight; tags and the toggle are the DS Tag and Segmented components. Untitled UI dark surfaces become Vivid Pink surfaces
Every plan is the Pricing card from the Cards page (marketing radius, card anatomy); the sections add no lookalike card

Billing toggle is the DS Segmented control (keyboard arrow keys, tablist roles), Yearly selected first, with a Save 33% DS Tag; prices swap in place with no animation and a status line announces the change

Comparison tables are semantic tables with a caption, column and row headers, a help tooltip on every row and DS Table values (60 px rows, dividers, grey hover); included and not-included are a check icon and a minus icon with hidden text, so meaning is not colour alone
Large table 02 has the two-thumb team-size range, like the original; on phones both tables become one block per plan with its own feature list

The billing toggle appears only where the Untitled UI original has one: the two large tables and seven of the twelve single-plan styles (Backdrop band uses the DS Switch); the other eight layouts show fixed prices
Plan names (Free, Essential, Pro, Enterprise), prices, periods and features are sample content to edit in place
Each section is a container-query block: it steps down at 991 px and 767 px wherever it sits

guidance.title: Choosing a background
guidance.intro: Every layout below has a White / Accent switch in its preview and a tab for each in its code.

points.title: White is the default
points.text: Use White unless the section needs to stand apart from the white sections around it. It is today's look and needs no extra class.

points.title: Accent
points.text: Add aha-pricing--accent to the section. It lays the pale pink Accent background (bgAccent) over white, so it looks the same wherever it sits. Plan cards and the comparison tables stay white, and the icon squares keep their white fill and grey border. The Plan card styles gallery has no switch: it already shows cards on a pale pink band and on Vivid Pink.

points.title: Neighbours
points.text: Never place an Accent section next to another coloured section. Put it between white sections.
